decision.observation: All three dupes are back on their feet and moving (one named 'Nails'), dig marks still cover the dirt block right of the platform and the tiles below it. Top bar shows Cycle 1 and 0% on an unclear meter, while ambient gas at the pod is 'Very Breathable' (~1.7 kg).
decision.hypothesis: Dupes are working again; expanding the dig area rightward into the sandstone will expose Copper Ore, the 200 kg of metal ore the Oxygen Diffuser needs.
decision.memory: The colony's real need is Metal Ore for the diffuser; copper ore tiles exist in this sandstone biome.
